title: Learn from error
outcome: Fit a linear model from scratch and compare it with a library implementation.

blocks.body: Question: How does a model learn its weights?
Mathematics: Learn limits through finite differences, derivatives, partial derivatives, gradients, and the chain rule.

Dataset: StatsBomb Open Data: competitions.json → matches/{competition_id}/{season_id}.json. Use scores, dates, and information available before kickoff. Build recent-form features only from earlier matches.
Reading: Mathematics for Machine Learning chapters 5 and 7. D2L calculus and linear regression sections.

blocks.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning
blocks.note: Use selected sections as a reference after the visual experiment. The authors provide a free PDF.

blocks.title: Dive into Deep Learning
blocks.note: Use the interactive book for calculus, automatic differentiation, training loops, and attention.

blocks.title: 3Blue1Brown · visual mathematics
blocks.note: Find the linear algebra and calculus lessons. Recreate one visual idea in code.

blocks.body: Challenge: Derive one weight update, compute it on a tiny example, and explain how the loss changes.

tasks.prompt: Plot an error curve. Estimate its slope with small input changes before using a derivative formula.
